summary: Two stranded campers in the Chicago Lake area near Mt Evans (Alpine mission 13-83)
notes: Alpine Rescue Team Clear Creek County category mission-log archive (Alpine mission 13-83); one-line page alert, outcome detail unstated in post.; paged 09/13/13 during the Front Range flood event; post does not link the stranding to flooding Merged: MRA Meridian (Fall 2013) identifies this as the 2013-09-13 mudslide rescue — the pair's tent was engulfed in a mudslide at ~11,000 ft near the base of Mt Evans; Alpine completed the rescue, then was stranded by a rockslide on the drive down, delaying response to other flood calls.
